statements.title: Import historical statements
statements.help: Upload up to five Merrill CMA or Charles Schwab PDFs. Monthly values extend balance history before calculated coverage; they do not establish investment returns. Later statements are retained for review only.
statements.upload: Monthly brokerage statements — Merrill or Charles Schwab (PDF, maximum 5)
statements.confirm: I verified the dates, values and account. I approve these snapshots and any displayed replacements.
statements.error: Could not process the statements. Check the format, account, currency, file limits and dates; reload before retrying a changed record.
statements.partial: Position details are incomplete. Missing basis is unknown; the reported account total remains available.
statements.replace: An existing snapshot for this date will be replaced. Review both values before confirming.
statements.carried: Monthly statement value · observed {{date}}; carried forward between statements
statements.incomplete: Partial history: some accounts have no observation for this date.

daily.title: Daily history from statements
daily.help: Reconstruct settlement-date values from complete Merrill or Charles Schwab statements. Review every asset link, cash movement and source section. Quotes are read locally; only Refresh historical prices contacts your configured market-data providers. Unsupported or pending transactions keep the month as a monthly snapshot. This does not change current holdings, transactions, cost approvals or investment returns.
daily.mappingHelp: Link each closing holding and each security transaction to a registered USD equity or ETF. Verify identity yourself, including securities sold during the month. Create missing securities in Settings first. Cash sweeps are already included in combined cash.
daily.events: Review dated events and transaction asset links
daily.reviewError: Could not validate this review. Check all asset links, cash and position reconciliation, interval overlaps and adjacent statement continuity. A changed record must be uploaded and reviewed again.
daily.fallback: Some daily values cannot be published. The reported closing total remains available; earlier monthly carry-forward values are labelled separately. Missing quotes are never treated as zero.
daily.confirm: I verified the account, USD currency, complete closing positions, all activity sections, dates, cash movements and asset identities against the full statement. I understand these are settlement-date values, with unknown basis and no contribution-adjusted returns.
daily.replace: This replaces a saved daily interval. Review the full statement and asset mappings again.
daily.coverage: Priced daily observations: {{priced}} of {{total}}. Closing statement totals remain authoritative.
daily.deleteHelp: To remove daily facts and their closing snapshot, switch to Monthly closing snapshots and delete that statement. To keep only its monthly total, upload it again in monthly mode.
daily.gaps: There are uncovered days between these statements. They are not reconstructed; any monthly carry-forward values are labelled as such.
daily.chart: Reconstructed statement history · settlement date · closing checkpoint {{date}}

handoffs.unverified: Continuity with live history is unverified. Historical periods are shown independently; no synthetic transactions are created.
handoffs.match: Cash and quantities match the live history on the common boundary date.
handoffs.mismatch: Cash or quantities differ from live history on the common boundary date. Historical values remain separate; verify the handoff before claiming continuous history.

qualities.CLOSING_PRICE_MISMATCH: Provider prices differ from the statement closing values

issues.missingActivitySections: No activity sections were extracted. Upload the full statement; use monthly mode if completeness cannot be verified.
issues.missingOpeningCash: The reported opening cash is missing.
issues.missingClosingCash: The reported closing cash is missing.
issues.incompleteClosingPositions: The complete closing position list could not be verified.
issues.unknownCashMovement: An activity has an unknown cash effect.
issues.cashMismatch: Opening cash plus the dated movements does not reconcile to closing cash.
issues.unsupportedActivity: A record has an unsupported or unresolved quantity/cash effect. Use monthly mode until the format is supported.
issues.unsettledTrades: Unsettled trades need a verified closing-position convention. This month remains eligible for monthly snapshots; daily reconstruction is blocked.
